title: 精密數位類比轉換器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究靜態線性、參考與動態建立；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate static linearity, references and dynamic settling. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

stages.title: 碼值與輸出
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「碼值與輸出」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for codes and outputs.

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。2ᴺ 個碼的最高碼是 2ᴺ−1，因此理想滿碼低於 Vref 一個 LSB。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「檢查零碼、中碼與滿碼的期望值。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. With 2ᴺ codes the highest is 2ᴺ−1, so ideal full-scale code is one LSB below Vref. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Check expected zero, midscale and full-scale-code values. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「精密數位類比轉換器」的「碼制與端點：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「訊號診所：雜訊與錯頻」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Coding and endpoints: model and design” in “Precision digital-to-analog converters”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Signal Clinic: Noise and Aliasing” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for coding and endpoints?

電流輸出 DAC 對端點電壓沒有任何限制。

steps.title: 碼制與端點：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Coding and endpoints: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「碼制與端點」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in coding and endpoints, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。檢查零碼、中碼與滿碼的期望值。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「2ᴺ 個碼的最高碼是 2ᴺ−1，因此理想滿碼低於 Vref 一個 LSB。」和待排除假說「16 位滿碼等於 65536。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Check expected zero, midscale and full-scale-code values. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “With 2ᴺ codes the highest is 2ᴺ−1, so ideal full-scale code is one LSB below Vref.” with the hypothesis to reject “The largest 16-bit code is 65536.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：檢查零碼、中碼與滿碼的期望值。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Check expected zero, midscale and full-scale-code values. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 檢查零碼、中碼與滿碼的期望值。
steps.observationEn: Check expected zero, midscale and full-scale-code values.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：16 位滿碼等於 65536。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: The largest 16-bit code is 65536. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：掃描相鄰碼增量的最小值。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Scan minimum adjacent-code increments. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 掃描相鄰碼增量的最小值。
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：單調就表示 INL 等於零。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Monotonicity implies zero INL. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.
